name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 🧪 Help us test: while Wingman is being tested, it keeps a record of what it hears, what you tap and the words it gets wrong, on your phone, so we can fix them. Wingman never listens when it isn't running, and only when you turn voice on. Change it any time with the 🧪 Testing button on Home.
🎙️ Sending your misheard recordings and sharing hive records for research stay off unless you turn them on.
☁️ Sign in from Home now opens your account section in full, just under the search bar.
